timing: Added after observing v1 resource failures, before examining bounded-control outcomes. This is explicitly post hoc development evidence.
trigger: All six known unsafe B candidates received UNKNOWN from both model gates because no usable witness fit the fixed 4096-token budget. Several B-exact valid sources were also withheld. This is availability rejection, not semantic detection success.
control: B + frozen controlled-language full-source parser + deterministic exact source-plan/candidate comparison
rationale: A bounded grammar is a smaller interpretable authorization witness with zero provider cost. It can test attainable exact coverage within the existing grammar and explicitly abstain outside it, without changing frozen B or tuning known-sample surface patterns.
unchanged: original two model-gate prompts and acquisition
data: Same already-seen 528 sources and shared B candidates. Run after original acquisitions; record a separate supplemental control artifact. No additional compiler provider calls.
claims: Grammar-bounded interpretation only. Parser/normalization/semantic conventions are trusted assumptions, not a proof of unrestricted Chinese language understanding. Coverage losses outside the grammar are retained. No held-out or adoption claim.
